criteria.text: `.github/workflows/jev-review.yml` triggers on `pull_request` with types `opened` and `synchronize` only. It requests `pull-requests: write`. Its job has `continue-on-error: true`. It reads `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` from `secrets`. It uploads `jev-review.json` with `if: always()`. (A test parses the YAML text for these keys.)
`estimateTokens('abcde')` is `2`. `overCap` returns a number for a 128 001-character diff with an empty spec, and `null` for a 1 000-character diff.
When `overCap` fires, `main` makes zero requests to the Decisions URL and upserts a comment containing `diff too large for Jev (` and the token count. The artifact then has `status: "too-large"`.

`findSpec` returns the most recent of two spec comments. It returns `null` when no comment has all three headings, including a comment that has Goal and API but no Acceptance criteria. It accepts both `## 5. Acceptance criteria` and `**Acceptance criteria**`.

`parseCriteria` on a spec with three numbered criteria, one of which has an indented sub-bullet, returns three items. The sub-bullet's text is inside its parent item, and numbered lines under `## 7. Test plan` are not included.

With a spec of N criteria, the request has N `ac-*` questions followed by the six convention ids in the fixed order. Without a spec it has exactly the six. Every question has `type: "noul"` and both `criteria.true` and `criteria.false`.

The request body's `model` is `typesafe/jev-1.13`. The keys of `state` are exactly `diff`, `spec` and `commits`. The serialized request contains no environment variable value (the test sets `OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-test` and asserts `sk-test` appears only in the `Authorization` header).
`renderComment` starts with `<!-- jev-review -->`, has one table row per question in question order, and ends with a `Custo:` line carrying `usage.cost`. A missing probability renders as `—`.

`upsertComment` PATCHes when a `github-actions[bot]` comment starts with the marker. It POSTs when none does, and also when the only marked comment belongs to another user. Two consecutive `main` runs against the same stub leave exactly one marked comment.
With an empty `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `main` resolves (does not reject), makes no network request, and writes `jev-review.json` with `status: "no-key"`.
When the Decisions stub answers 500, or with a non-JSON body, `main` resolves. It upserts a comment containing `Jev indisponível` and writes `status: "api-error"`.
When the comment upsert stub answers 403, `main` still resolves and still writes the artifact.

The docs (`test/docs.ts`'s `docsText`) name the `jev-review` workflow and the `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` secret. They state that it only comments and never blocks a merge, and they list the six convention checks. `test/docs-drift.test.ts` does not cover this, because it is about collectors only.

No test file whose name starts with an issue number is added. The new tests live in `test/jev.test.ts`. `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass, and no test reaches the network: every `fetch` and `git` call is stubbed.

Manual: on the PR that ships this workflow, after the secret is set, the Actions run posts one comment. A second push edits that comment in place (still one marked comment), and the run page lists the `jev-review` artifact.
